title: Invariant affine neighbourhoods of codimension-at-most-one orbits in a finite groupoid

standard_prerequisites.name: Explicit prerequisite boundary
standard_prerequisites.reference: Stable Stacks tags retained in assembly.external_references
standard_prerequisites.use: Finite groupoid schemes, separated locally Noetherian schemes, affine neighbourhoods of finite codimension-one sets, finite-flat loci, integral modifications and invariant opens. The local finite-flat and affine-integral support is retained.

core_obligations: Reduce through integral modifications and isolate a dense invariant locus where the finite groupoid becomes finite locally free, retaining the local reduction lemmas.
Handle orbit points outside that flat locus by the codimension-one construction and produce a single invariant affine neighbourhood containing the orbit.

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce through integral modifications and isolate a dense invariant locus where the finite groupoid becomes finite locally free, retaining the local reduction lemmas.
Handle orbit points outside that flat locus by the codimension-one construction and produce a single invariant affine neighbourhood containing the orbit.

difficulty_reason: Finiteness without flatness is the point: the orbit can meet the nonflat codimension-one boundary. The source constructs an invariant affine neighbourhood there rather than applying the finite-flat invariant-ring quotient directly, supporting H2.

compared.difference: This migrates the existing unpublished research record, not an additional count beside it.
